scheme_name: Bus Traveling Facility For Visually Impaired/Bus Concession
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Delhi.
Must have a disability of 40% or higher.
Must obtain a card from the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM) before applying at the depot.
Concession for the escort is provided only to applicants with 100% blindness.
benefits_summary: Free travel on DTC buses for visually impaired persons, with a 50% fare concession for the escort if the applicant has 100% blindness.
